A '''battle''' was fought in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], at the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Trasemene]], between an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] task force made up of the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]], and a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] with her [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Defiance's Banner]]''. During the battle, Imperial forces under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] triumphed after the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] ripped apart the Separatist holdout fleet with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|batteries]].

==Prelude==
After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended in a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] defeat in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] ex-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] managed to gather an [[Army/Legends|army]] of former Confederate forces and continued to fight on against the victorious [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. That led to the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the successor of the Republic, strove to destroy Toora's [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] army in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth's]] vicinity. After [[Battle of Diado|consecutive]] Imperial [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|victories]] at the worlds of [[Diado]] and [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], and later the [[Siege of Sy Myrth|siege]] of Sy Myrth itself, an Imperial task force of the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], led by the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']], chased down Toora's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Defiance's Banner]]''.<ref name="Warfare" />

==The battle==
After Toora's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was cornered at the planet [[Trasemene]], the ''Battalion''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|batteries]] ripped apart her fleet, resulting in an Imperial victory. Toora was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Aftermath==
The action at Trasemene ended the Sy Myrthian Insurrection, though Confederate followers still harassed the Empire from the [[Kreetan Narrows]] region in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which later led to the northern [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] territories being [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] by the Imperials. Dodonna later won honors for his role in defeating Toora's resistance.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
